ns2:section.sectionText: Through case studies, interactive projects, and hands-on activities, students will learn the fundamentals of service learning and technical skills that will guide them in future project work. This course will introduce students to the history and culture of Guatemala and follows with a service learning experience in Guatemala. Students will travel over the winter break to Guatemala and volunteer with a local NGO to build a home for a local family. Tentative program dates are January 6-15, 2020. There is a program fee of $2850, which includes roundtrip airfare from Chicago, lodging, on-the-ground transportation costs, and most meals. Scholarships are available. Students with financial need or other questions, please contact the iPENG Office for more information. Class meets beginning October 3.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
